description:
Returns a Range object that represents a cell or a range of cells.
When applied to a Range object, the property is relative to that Range object.

params.description: The second cell address (optional, defines the corner with "cell1").
params.name: cell2

returns.description: Returns the range relative to this range, or null if invalid.

signature: GetRange(cell1: string | ApiRange, cell2?: string | ApiRange): ApiRange | null
